attchmntText: Ahlada Engineers Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Ahlada Engineers Limited approved un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026 during its Board meeting on 14th November 2026. Revenue from operations for the quarter was 4,424.23 lakhs, with a profit after tax of 9.36 lakhs. Earnings per share stood at 0.07. For the half year, revenue from operations was 6,826.86 lakhs, and profit after tax was 26.84 lakhs. Earnings per share for the half year were 0.21. The statutory auditors, M M Reddy & Co., issued a limited review report stating no material misstatements were found. Total assets as of 30th September 2026 were 24,689.02 lakhs. Equity share capital remained at 1,292.10 lakhs. The results are available on the company website and NSE.
